channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-gbdev
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: rgbds-structs — via awesome-gbdev
item.description: A macro pack that provides struct-like functionality.

item.title: rgbds-arrays — via awesome-gbdev
item.description: A macro pack that provides array-like functionality.

item.title: regex.inc — via awesome-gbdev
item.description: A regular expression parser in assembly macros.

item.title: gbz80-highlight — via awesome-gbdev
item.description: Notepad+- and gedit syntax highlighting files for RGBDS assembly.

item.title: gb-vwf — via awesome-gbdev
item.description: Library to print variable-width text, comes with a demo.

item.title: gb-starter-kit — via awesome-gbdev
item.description: An expansion on the above, including base library code as well to get started faster.

item.title: gb-boilerplate — via awesome-gbdev
item.description: A template for starting Game Boy projects, providing a Makefile for infrastructure.

item.title: Tessarium — via awesome-gbdev
item.description: ‡ - Tile-first pixel art level editor with linked tile editing, shared tilesets, and live unique tile and colours-per-tile budget checks for Game Boy and Game Boy Color backgrounds.

item.title: LLVM-Z80 — via awesome-gbdev
item.description: † - A fork of LLVM with a backend for the Game Boy CPU (SM83), supporting the latest C standards and LLVM’s excellent optimizations.

item.title: Game Boy Demospotting — via awesome-gbdev
item.description: An archive of Game Boy software demos made from 1996 to 2020.

item.title: Super Mario Land 2 - Memory Exploration — via awesome-gbdev
item.description: Video by Retro Game Mechanics Explained on how the game stores levels in memory, and what happens when Mario goes out of bounds.

item.title: DraconicGB: Creating a Game Boy Emulator — via awesome-gbdev
item.description: Bachelor's thesis (UOC, 2020) documenting the research, architecture and C++ implementation of a Game Boy emulator, with an overview of the hardware and of existing emulators.

item.title: DOTs for GBC — via awesome-gbdev
item.description: Making of a Game Boy Color port of the Dots game in C with GBDK, from code to a physical cartridge with box art. Includes the source code and a one-hour development commentary video.
